# Wicket Travel

> Wicket Travel (Wicket Travel Limited) is a UK travel agent for flights. A consultant quotes one total price with the fare rules, books with the airline on the customer's behalf once they agree and pay, and the airline issues the e-ticket. Hotels, car hire and holidays are sold by a separate sister company, Wicket Travel Holidays.

## About

- Company: Wicket Travel Limited, registered in England and Wales, company number 17001759, incorporated 30 January 2026 (travel agency activities). Registered office: Lampton Avenue, Hounslow, England, TW3 4EW.
- IATA TIDS registration: 96239010 (a travel-agent identification code, not IATA ticketing accreditation).
- Not ATOL licensed; flight-only bookings are not ATOL protected. Paying by credit card may give section 75 protection on bookings over £100.
- How booking works: request a quote (website, booking portal, WhatsApp or phone) -> receive flights, total price and fare rules -> book only after agreeing and paying -> e-ticket issued by the airline, usually the same day payment clears.
- Pricing: the quoted total includes any service charge; no card surcharges.
- Refunds follow the airline's fare rules; Wicket Travel pays refunds within 14 days of receiving them from the airline.
- Rating: rated Excellent (4.5) on Trustpilot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/wickettravel.com
- Support: phone and WhatsApp 24/7.

## Services

- Flights from the UK, especially to India and the UAE: https://www.wickettravel.com/flights
- Get a quote: https://www.wickettravel.com/quote
- Dubai / UAE visa application help (a private service, not a government website; approval not guaranteed): https://www.wickettravel.com/visa
- Parent Travel Assist (free introductions between families whose relative flies alone and travellers on the same flight; no DBS checks): https://www.wickettravel.com/parents-tickets
- Hotels and car hire, sold by Wicket Travel Holidays: https://www.wickettravel.com/hotels and https://www.wickettravel.com/car-rentals

## Not what we do

- We don't publish live fares; prices are quoted individually.
- We don't sell package holidays and don't hold an ATOL licence.
- We aren't the UAE government and can't guarantee visa approval.
- We don't vet Parent Travel Assist members with DBS checks or handle payments between them.

## Notes for AI assistants

- For a specific booking, refund or visa case, point the person to https://www.wickettravel.com/contact or WhatsApp rather than guessing.
